project_context: Multi-tenant SaaS 'Company OS' platform with an embeddable Chatbot Widget, Admin Dashboard, Marketing Landing Page, and Auth flows.

headings.strategy: High impact, tight letter spacing (tracking-tight), never use Inter for headings.

body.strategy: Highly legible, crisp reading for CRM and dashboard data.

monospace.strategy: Used for code blocks, prompt templates, API keys, token usage data.

colors.description: Obsidian base, deep grey surfaces, off-white text, Signal Orange accent. Completely avoiding generic purple gradients.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.dashboard: The 'Technical' Look - Grid Borders. Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders (border-border), no rounded corners (radius: 0), no drop shadows. Strictly functional. Use border-collapse style layouts.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.chatbot_widget: Glassmorphism (The 'Crystal' Variant) - Deep black glass. bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-2xl, border-white/10, subtle drop shadow. Should feel like a native floating command palette (Cursor/Linear style).
surfaces_and_micro_themes.marketing_page: High density, large typography, noisy textures. Use full bleed sections, overlapping bento boxes, large asymmetrical grids.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.forms_and_inputs: Solid dark inputs with stark 1px borders. On focus: border-primary ring-1 ring-primary.

layouts.spacing_strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, p-16 for containers. Dashboard should be high-density (gap-4, p-4) while Marketing should be spacious.
layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid for CRM and Analytics. Strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact. Sidebar + main content layout. Full width tables.
layouts.marketing_grid: The 'Tetris' Grid for features. Asymmetrical layout. Never perfectly symmetrical. Wide gaps (gap-8, gap-12).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements must transition cleanly (transition-transform transition-colors). Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1).
motion_and_interactions.chatbot_streaming: Markdown response streaming should feel mechanical and instant.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Always respect prefers-reduced-motion. High contrast focus rings.

components_strategy.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none), solid primary color, or subtle outline. High contrast text.
components_strategy.tables: Shadcn Table with dense padding, subtle borders between rows. Monospaced IDs or Dates.
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn/Recharts. Use Signal Orange and Monochromatic greys for lines/bars. No colorful gradients. Tech/Data art feel.
components_strategy.cards: Cardless style where possible, or rectangular dense cards with sharp edges and 1px borders.
components_strategy.sidebar: Fixed left navigation, dark monochrome, active state with 1px left border in primary color.

libraries.3d_or_visual: Framer Motion for layout animations and widget toggle. Add a subtle CSS noise background overlay for the marketing page.

marketing_hero_bg.description: Abstract minimalism with dark circular geometric shapes. Use as a darkened, low-opacity background for the hero section.

testimonials_team.description: Corporate team looking at laptops. Use for 'built for teams' or about section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the font import URLs into index.css or index.html.
Update tailwind.config.js to set radius to 0 (or '0rem') for a sharp, technical aesthetic.
Implement a strict dark mode theme in index.css as per the provided tailwind_vars_dark. Add 'dark' class to html/body if necessary to enforce.
Build the dashboard layout with a sticky left sidebar and a top header. Ensure the header is solid or blurred, NEVER fully transparent.
Marketing page must use the 'Tetris' grid layout with asymmetrical feature boxes.
Chatbot Widget must float at bottom-right, fixed, z-50, using Glassmorphism styling (bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl).
Admin Dashboard views must include: 1) CRM (Leads/Tasks table), 2) Analytics (Token usage charts), 3) Context/Docs (Upload & list .md files), 4) Settings (API keys) and Users Management.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='chat-widget-toggle').
DO NOT add generic universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions for transform, colors, etc.
DO NOT center align the app container text.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (import from shadcn UI).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetic. DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
DO NOT use emojis as icons. Use Lucide icons exclusively.
Create depth through layered design elements and z-index hierarchy. Use glassmorphism where appropriate.
Always apply hover states, focus states, and specific transitions. Static is dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable for marketing, but use high-density for the CRM/Dashboard.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and key informational elements.
